targetJournals.name: Nature Human Behaviour
targetJournals.focus: Generalizable human behaviour insights with strong conceptual framing and transparent empirical limits.
targetJournals.audience: Interdisciplinary behavioural science and computational social science editors/reviewers.
methodsExpectations: Clear behavioural relevance beyond a purely technical model
Conservative claim language with explicit inferential boundaries
deskRejectTriggers: Method-heavy framing with weak behavioural interpretation
Overstated novelty or universal claims under sparse support
Insufficient separation between descriptive and inferential evidence

framingAdjustments.abstract: Lead with bounded methodological contribution and explicit non-causal scope.
framingAdjustments.introduction: Position the model as a transparency-first comparative inference tool under support constraints.
framingAdjustments.conclusion: Prioritize inferential boundaries and reproducibility over broad behavioural generalization.

targetJournals.name: EPJ Data Science
targetJournals.focus: Reproducible data-science methodology for complex social systems with auditable computation.
targetJournals.audience: Computational social science, data science, and methodological reviewers.
methodsExpectations: Methodological novelty grounded in diagnostic evidence
deskRejectTriggers: Missing reproducibility path from data to claims
Narrative claims not tightly linked to exported artifacts

framingAdjustments.abstract: Emphasize auditable workflow, protocolized validation, and support-aware interpretation.
framingAdjustments.introduction: Highlight contribution as computational methodology for sparse macro panels.
framingAdjustments.conclusion: Stress reusable reproducibility infrastructure and evidence-traceable claims.

targetJournals.name: Social Networks
targetJournals.focus: Network-theoretic mechanisms, relational structure, and network-specific empirical design.
targetJournals.audience: Network science and computational sociology reviewers.
methodsExpectations: Explicit network representation or relational mechanism
Claims centered on network formation/diffusion structure
deskRejectTriggers: No network data structure in modeling design
Macro panel claims without relational mechanism
General computational claims without network contribution

framingAdjustments.abstract: Avoid positioning as a network-method contribution unless relational structure is modeled directly.
framingAdjustments.introduction: If targeting this venue, add explicit network mechanism scope limits.
framingAdjustments.conclusion: Present as adjacent methodology, not a direct network-method advance.

majorClaims.claim: A bounded nonlinear map provides interpretable regime geometry for macro-urban belief outcomes.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Methodologically strong, but behavioural mechanism linkage must stay explicit.
rationale.epj_data_science: Core method-forward contribution with clear diagnostic interpretability.
rationale.social_networks: No explicit relational network representation in the model contract.

majorClaims.claim: The pipeline is reproducible, auditable, and artifact-traceable from preprocessing to exported diagnostics.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Necessary but not sufficient without stronger behavioural framing.
rationale.epj_data_science: Directly aligned with journal expectations for computational reproducibility.
rationale.social_networks: Valued as method hygiene, but not a network-specific contribution.

majorClaims.claim: Primary inferential evidence is protocolized through refit OOS checks and a release-gated lockbox holdout.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Strong robustness signal if linked to substantive interpretation limits.
rationale.epj_data_science: Excellent alignment with rigorous validation and anti-overfitting standards.
rationale.social_networks: Robust protocol quality helps, but domain focus remains non-network.

majorClaims.claim: In-sample agreement metrics are strong on the bounded scale for the canonical panel.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Should remain secondary to interpretability and inferential restraint.
rationale.epj_data_science: Acceptable as descriptive performance when tied to protocol diagnostics.
rationale.social_networks: Performance metrics alone do not create network relevance.

majorClaims.claim: Sensitivity is regime-dependent, peaking near the transition ridge and attenuating in saturated tails.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Useful only if connected to behavioural interpretation constraints.
rationale.epj_data_science: Strong model-geometry insight with clear diagnostic value.
rationale.social_networks: Regime geometry is not framed through relational network mechanisms.

majorClaims.claim: Interpretation is support-constrained by 34 unique country-years and uneven regime density.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Editorially positive because inferential limits are explicit.
rationale.epj_data_science: Aligned with transparent uncertainty and support auditing.
rationale.social_networks: General scientific rigor is valuable even outside direct network scope.

majorClaims.claim: Claims are descriptive and non-causal; policy-optimal recommendations are explicitly out of scope.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Reduces overclaiming risk at desk screen.
rationale.epj_data_science: Strengthens claim-evidence discipline for method papers.
rationale.social_networks: Supports conservative interpretation despite topical mismatch.

majorClaims.claim: The main contribution is an auditable computational workflow for support-aware macro-comparative inference.

rationale.nature_human_behaviour: Acceptable if behavioural scope remains carefully bounded.
rationale.epj_data_science: Direct match to journal-level methodological relevance.
rationale.social_networks: Useful but peripheral unless network structure is introduced.

summaryByJournal.recommendedPositioning: Behaviour-relevant but method-forward framing with strict inferential boundaries.
Primary target: reproducible computational methodology with protocolized validation.
Secondary/conditional target unless explicit network-relational modeling is added.
